# TextProjection

Type alias · [Source](https://github.com/schmayterling/hibi/blob/main/src/shared/document-projection.ts#L2)

Analysis offsets and source offsets are UTF-16. Every span is an exact identity mapping.

<details>

```typescript
type TextProjection = {

  text: string

}
```
